Test databases

The generated SQLite fixtures used by the Electron test suite.

For Developers 79 words 1 min read tests/fixtures/databases/README.md ↗
Electronfixtures

⚠️ LEGACY — Electron implementation (status as of 2026-07-10)#

These fixtures belong to the legacy Electron/Node.js test suite. The primary, actively developed product is now the Windows Native app (.NET 8 / WinUI 3) under windows-native/. See windows-native/TESTING.md for the primary test suite.

This directory contains test databases of various sizes.

Run npm run test:seed to generate:

  • test-tiny.db (10 events)
  • test-small.db (100 events)
  • test-medium.db (500 events)
  • test-large.db (1,000 events)
  • test-stress.db (5,000+ events)

These databases are .gitignored and generated on-demand.
